meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small: one conversion function in the codex provider path plus a reply validation against the full schema.

body.focus: ISSUE-487ad7a67474d321: send codex only the schema keywords OpenAI strict mode accepts. The codex paths in CliProvider send codexSchemaJson(schema) (processSchemaForOpenAIStrict); strict mode refuses keywords such as uniqueItems (analyzer bundle schema meta.emptyLayers), so codex fails 400 invalid_json_schema. Fix: the copy sent to codex leaves out (or rewrites) every keyword strict mode refuses, with the refused set established by probing codex rather than assumed; the caller's schema is unchanged, and the codex reply is still validated against the caller's full schema so no constraint is lost.
body.summary: The codex copy of a schema (codexStrictSchema, structured-output.ts) keeps only the keywords codex was probed to accept and no format but date-time. A schema is refused before codex is called when it holds a format the reply check cannot enforce, or when the final strict copy holds a local $ref that no longer resolves; both scans read schema maps by value. Both codex paths in CliProvider send the copy and check the reply against the caller's full schema with validateCodexReply (ajv draft 2020-12 + ajv-formats). Shared processSchemaForOpenAIStrict and validateAgainstSchema are unchanged. Probe script, raw results and the live check are in S001/codex-strict-probe.md. Eight tests; each rule has a mutation that fails them.
